title: Shipping Policy
content:
MDK Electronics

At MDK Electronics we aim to deliver your orders quickly and safely across Pakistan.

Delivery Time

All orders are delivered within 3 to 5 working days depending on your location.

Order Processing

Orders are processed within 24 hours after confirmation.

Courier Services

We use trusted courier partners such as Leopard Courier and TCS to ensure safe and timely delivery.

Shipping Charges

Delivery charges are calculated and shown at the time of checkout.

Delivery Delays

In case of unexpected delays due to weather or courier issues customers will be informed accordingly.

Incorrect Address

Customers are responsible for providing correct shipping details. MDK Electronics will not be responsible for delays due to incorrect information.

title: Terms & Conditions
content:
Welcome to the website of MDK Electronics. By accessing or using our website and purchasing our products, you agree to comply with the following terms and conditions. Please read these terms carefully before using our website.

Website Usage

By using this website, you confirm that you will use it only for lawful purposes. You agree not to misuse the website in any way that may damage, disable, or interfere with the normal functioning of the website or its services.

Unauthorized use of this website may give rise to legal claims and may be considered a criminal offense under applicable laws.

Product Information

We try our best to provide accurate descriptions, specifications, and images of all products listed on our website. However:

• Product images are for illustration purposes only
• Actual product color or design may slightly differ
• Specifications may change depending on manufacturer updates

We reserve the right to update product information at any time without prior notice.

Pricing Policy

All prices listed on our website are subject to change without notice. While we strive to ensure that all pricing information is accurate, errors may occasionally occur.

If a pricing error is discovered after an order has been placed, we reserve the right to cancel the order and inform the customer accordingly.

Orders & Acceptance

Placing an order on our website does not automatically mean that the order is accepted. We reserve the right to review and verify each order.

We may cancel or refuse an order in certain situations, including:

• Incorrect pricing or product information
• Suspicious or fraudulent transactions
• Product unavailability

If your order is canceled, our team will inform you through phone or email.

Customer Responsibilities

Customers are responsible for providing accurate and complete information when placing orders, including:

• Correct name
• Valid phone number
• Accurate delivery address

If incorrect information is provided and delivery fails, we will not be responsible for delays or additional charges.

Payments

Customers must complete payment using the payment methods provided on the website. Orders will only be processed after payment confirmation.

Payments made are generally non-refundable, except in cases where the product received is defective, damaged, or broken, as stated in our Return & Refund Policy.

Limitation of Liability

MDK Electronics will not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our website or products.

We are not responsible for delays caused by courier companies, natural events, or circumstances beyond our control.

Changes to Terms

We reserve the right to update or modify these Terms & Conditions at any time without prior notice. Continued use of the website after any changes indicates your acceptance of the updated terms.

title: Return & Refund Policy
content:
At MDK Electronics, customer satisfaction is our top priority. If you receive a defective, damaged, or broken product, you may request a return or replacement within 7 days of receiving the item.

Return Conditions

• Product must be defective, damaged, or broken
• Product must be in its original packaging
• Proof of purchase must be provided
• Products damaged due to misuse are not eligible for return

Refunds & Replacements

After inspecting the returned item, we will:

• Provide a replacement or
• Issue a refund depending on the situation

Note: Shipping charges are non-refundable unless the issue is caused by us.

Contact for Returns

To initiate a return, contact us at:

title: Privacy Policy
content:
Welcome to MDK Electronics. Your privacy is very important to us, and we are committed to protecting your personal information whenever you visit or make a purchase from our website

Information We Collect

When you place an order, contact us, or interact with our website, we may collect certain basic information including:

• Full Name
• Phone Number
• Email Address
• Shipping Address
• Order Details

This information is collected only for the purpose of providing our services and ensuring a smooth shopping experience for our customers.

How We Use Your Information

The information we collect may be used for the following purposes:

• Processing and confirming your orders
• Delivering products to your address
• Providing customer support and responding to inquiries
• Improving our website and services
• Sending important updates related to your order

We ensure that your information is handled responsibly and securely.

Information Sharing

At MDK Electronics, we value the trust of our customers.

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to any third party. Your information may only be shared with trusted service providers such as courier companies for the purpose of delivering your order or when required by law.

Cookies and Website Usage

Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to enhance user experience, analyze website traffic, and improve website performance.

Cookies help us understand how visitors use our website so we can continue to improve our services.

Data Security

We take reasonable security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure.

However, while we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your information, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure.

Your Consent

By using our website and services, you agree to the terms outlined in this Privacy Policy and consent to the collection and use of your information as described above.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, you can contact us at:

title: About Us
content:
About MDK Electronics

Who We Are

Welcome to MDK Electronics, your premier destination for innovative gadgets and cutting-edge security solutions. Based in the heart of Karkhano Market, Peshawar, we specialize in providing high-quality electronics that blend functionality with modern technology.

From powerful portable audio systems like the W-KING T9 Pro to advanced Hidden and CCTV Cameras, we bring you the latest tech that the market has to offer.

Our Story

MDK Electronics was founded with a simple mission: to make advanced technology accessible and affordable for everyone in Pakistan.

We understand that in today’s world, security and entertainment go hand-in-hand. That’s why we have curated a collection of products that help you protect what matters most and enjoy your life to the fullest.

With our physical flagship store located in Shinwari Plaza, Karkhano Market, we have built a reputation for authenticity, reliability, and trusted service.

Why Shop With Us

• Physical Presence, Online Convenience: Unlike many online-only stores, we have a real-world shop in Peshawar, so you can trust us for quality and after-sales support.

• Curated Tech: We don’t just sell everything—we sell the right products. Every camera, flash drive, and speaker is tested for performance before it reaches you.

• Privacy & Security Experts: We specialize in hidden security solutions to help you keep an eye on your home or office discreetly and effectively.

• Fast & Reliable Delivery: We ensure your orders reach you quickly and safely, no matter where you are in Pakistan.

Our Commitment

At MDK Electronics, customer satisfaction is our top priority. We believe in building long-term relationships with our clients by offering:

  • Transparent pricing
  • Genuine products
  • Expert advice and support

Your trust is our most valuable asset.
